"""Minimal PE inspector + strings extractor. Process tool for g5-a analysis."""
import struct, sys, re

def pe_info(path):
    d = open(path, 'rb').read()
    print(f"file: {path}  size={len(d)}")
    if d[:2] != b'MZ':
        print("not MZ"); return
    e_lfanew = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, 0x3c)[0]
    assert d[e_lfanew:e_lfanew+4] == b'PE\0\0'
    coff = e_lfanew + 4
    machine, nsec, tstamp, symtab, nsym, optsz, chars = struct.unpack_from('<HHIIIHH', d, coff)
    opt = coff + 20
    magic = struct.unpack_from('<H', d, opt)[0]
    pe32p = magic == 0x20b
    entry = struct.unpack_from('<I', d, opt + 16)[0]
    imgbase = struct.unpack_from('<Q' if pe32p else '<I', d, opt + 24)[0]
    print(f"machine={machine:#x} sections={nsec} optsz={optsz} pe32+={pe32p} entry={entry:#x} imagebase={imgbase:#x}")
    secs = []
    so = opt + optsz
    for i in range(nsec):
        name = d[so + i*40: so + i*40 + 8].rstrip(b'\0').decode('latin1')
        vsize, vaddr, rsize, raddr = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', d, so + i*40 + 8)
        secs.append((name, vaddr, vsize, raddr, rsize))
        print(f"  sec {name:8s} vaddr={vaddr:#010x} vsize={vsize:#010x} rawaddr={raddr:#010x} rawsize={rsize:#010x}")
    # overlay = data after last raw section
    end = max(r + s for (_, _, _, r, s) in secs) if secs else len(d)
    ov = d[end:]
    print(f"overlay: offset={end:#x} size={len(ov)}")
    # resource directory
    ddoff = opt + (112 if pe32p else 96)
    rva_size = struct.unpack_from('<II', d, ddoff + 2*8)  # dir entry 2 = resources
    print(f"resource dir rva={rva_size[0]:#x} size={rva_size[1]:#x}")
    return d, secs, end, ov

def rva2off(rva, secs):
    for name, vaddr, vsize, raddr, rsize in secs:
        if vaddr <= rva < vaddr + max(vsize, rsize):
            return raddr + (rva - vaddr)
    return None

def strings(path, minlen=6, enc='ascii', limit=100000):
    d = open(path, 'rb').read()
    if enc == 'ascii':
        pat = re.compile(rb'[\x20-\x7e]{%d,}' % minlen)
        return [m.group().decode('ascii') for m in pat.finditer(d)][:limit]
    else:  # utf16le
        pat = re.compile(rb'(?:[\x20-\x7e]\x00){%d,}' % minlen)
        return [m.group().decode('utf-16le') for m in pat.finditer(d)][:limit]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    path = sys.argv[1]
    d, secs, end, ov = pe_info(path)
    mode = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'info'
    if mode == 'strings':
        mn = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 6
        for s in strings(path, mn):
            print(s)
    elif mode == 'wstrings':
        mn = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 4
        for s in strings(path, mn, 'u'):
            print(s)
    elif mode == 'overlay':
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(d[end:])
